common.chooseBusiness: Choose a business to see this page.
i18n.draftHint: This language was drafted by machine and is waiting for a reviewer. Some words may read oddly.
lang.title: Languages
lang.intro: Choose the language you work in and the languages the AI may reply in. A language appears once ExaCarib has switched it on.
lang.mineHint: Changes these screens for you only. Dates, numbers and money follow it too.
lang.aiHint: The AI answers in the customer's language when it is ticked here, and in the business language otherwise.
lang.cataloguesHint: Each draft stays marked machine-drafted until a fluent reviewer signs it off.
q.title: Quality
q.intro: Check conversations against your own standards, find the questions nobody could answer, and keep the promises made to customers.
q.criteriaHint: Write each one as something a good conversation does. The reviewer quotes the conversation for every score.
q.noCriteria: No criteria yet. Add the first one below.
q.nothingJudged: Nothing to judge in this period.
q.quoteDropped: A quote didn't match the conversation and was removed.
q.flagsHint: A person looks at each one and notes what happens next.
q.gapsHint: {n} open, grouped by topic. Draft an article from a group; a person approves it before the AI uses it.
q.draftHint: Check every fact and replace each [Check: …] before approving. The AI uses it only once approved.
q.followupsHint: Found where someone promised to come back to a customer. The owner gets a reminder when it falls due.
q.csatHint: After a conversation is resolved, the customer gets one short question on the channel they used, within that channel's rules.
q.csatCooldown: Days before asking the same customer again
g.title: AI governance
g.intro: Every change to the AI's model or instructions runs these tests before it goes live. Results are kept.
g.suiteHint: Your own questions, plus {n} from ExaCarib that every business runs.
g.candidatesHint: A change goes live only after it passes every test and someone promotes it.
g.question: Question
g.questionExample: What time do you open on Saturday?
g.limitsHint: How many actions each role may take in a day. Beyond the limit, actions are refused until tomorrow.
g.globalHint: Run for every business before a model change goes live. Live model: {model}.
team.title: Team
team.intro: Notifications and staff chat. Staff chat is internal: customers, channels and the AI never see it.
team.chatHint: Direct and group messages between colleagues in this business.
team.messagePlaceholder: Write to your colleagues. Use @name to mention someone.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.attachToNote: Attach files to the note (text, CSV, PDF, images; up to 5 MB each)
inbox.aiRead: What the AI read from attachments
